units.source_text: 是晚两人彻夜不眠，吟诗唱和，直达天明。

en.t: That night the two of them stayed awake until dawn, composing poems and answering each other in verse.

units.source_text: 宰相终于担心此行遭人物议，急欲还都。

en.t: At last the chancellor grew worried that this journey would draw criticism, and he was eager to return to the capital.
Their hurried meeting only deepened their sorrow.

units.source_text: 源氏公子便命取酒来饯别，共吟白居易“醉悲洒泪春杯里”之诗。

en.t: Prince Genji then ordered wine to be brought for a farewell cup, and together they recited Bai Juyi's verse about drunken grief and tears falling into a spring cup.

units.source_text: 左右随从之人，闻之无不垂泪。

en.t: All the attendants around them wept when they heard it.

units.source_text: 他们也各自与相熟的人道别。

en.t: They too each said farewell to the people they knew well.

units.source_text: 黎明的天空中，飞过几行征雁。

en.t: Across the dawn sky, several lines of migrating geese flew past.

units.source_text: 主人触景生情，便赋诗云：

en.t: Moved by the scene, the host composed a poem and said:
